About Us

Your local barber shop in Billericay, Essex

JK Traditional Barbers is located at 18 Western Road, Billericay, Essex, CM12 9DZ — and we're proud to be one of the best barbershops in Billericay. We work with gents of all ages and kids, and our mission is simple: provide the highest quality barbering services around. Our core services are haircuts, shaving, trimming, men's facials and treatments.

Our professional team in Billericay prides itself on reliable service for every client, whether you're searching for a barber near me locally or visiting from further afield in Wickford, Basildon, Shenfield or South Essex — and even regulars who travel in from London. We use top-quality Belmont barber chairs so your visit is as comfortable as it is stylish — and whatever look you're after, our team will get it right.

We cover everything from basic haircuts and kids' trims to luxury hot towel shaves, beard styling, facials and grooming treatments. Clients regularly praise us for friendly banter, consistent attention to detail, and a genuinely welcoming environment — many stay loyal customers even after moving away from Billericay. Walk-ins are always welcome, though it's smart to ring ahead during peak weekend hours to check wait times.
